content:
**Design doc**: .design/llm-moderation-assist.md
**Implements**: REQ-A2, REQ-C3 step 1

**Files to add**:
- polaris-backend/src/llm/mod.rs (new module)
- polaris-backend/src/llm/case_context.rs — `pub async fn hydrate(pool: &PgPool, case_id: Uuid) -> Result<RecommendRequest, HydrateError>`

**Hydration joins**:
- subjects (DID, kind, created_at, first_seen_by_mod)
- incidents (severity, status, related subjects via the join table)
- reports (category, body, reporter_did)
- observations (all kinds; classifier signals + pattern outputs + upstream labels)
- actions (prior actions on this subject; chronological; reasoning + cited policies — but NOT moderator_id, privacy floor)
- mod_policies where scope covers subject.kind (current versions; decision_criteria, examples)
- subject post text + embeds via the existing media-walker / post hydration

**Rust quality**:
- One pool, multiple parameterized queries (sqlx::query!)
- Privacy: PriorAction omits moderator_id (REQ-A2 privacy boundary)
- Page-size caps: max 20 reports, max 50 observations, max 50 prior actions per RecommendRequest (configurable)
- Memoize per-policy lookup via mod_policies LRU cache

**Tests**:
- tests/case_context_hydrate.rs — fixture case with 3 reports + 5 observations + 2 prior actions; assert RecommendRequest shape

**Blocked by**: #LLM-1, #LLM-3
